race.title: Mr Binman Christmas Racing Festival 26th - 29th December Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
race.verdict: A dual winner in May, ZOLPHARINE returned to form when runner-up over fences at Clonmel last time and he can build on that effort as he reverts to hurdling. He gets the vote ahead of Good Bye Milan , who capitalised on a career-low mark at Gowran recently, while Mellem could also be in the mix. ZOLPHARINE (IRE) GOOD BYE MILAN (IRE) MELLEM (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: The Cobblers Wife (4/1), Ardera Gun (9/2), Talas Kera (5/1), Agent Tequila (7/1), Good Bye Milan (7/1), Solar Generation (8/1), Johnny Cakes (10/1), Zolpharine (10/1), Calzaghi (10/1), Mellem (12/1), Ballinaboola Hanna (25/1), Free A Minute (25/1), Lily Milan (25/1), Jacenry (25/1), Seeitoldya (33/1), Fenian Maxios (50/1), Renard De Noir (66/1)
